lh-filter: Line chart of a synthetic 365-day hydrograph. Total flow (cyan line) has 15 storm peaks between about 4 and 9 synthetic units on a slowly varying seasonal baseflow of 1 to 3.3 units; the Lyne-Hollick baseflow (green area, alpha 0.925) follows the slow trend and the quickflow (blue) fills the space between baseflow and total flow. Title: BFI 0.742.
